title: Shortest routes on a road map
prompt: Read from standard input a road map and some questions. The first line is `N M`: N towns numbered 1 to N and M roads. The next M lines are `A B D`: a two-way road between towns A and B of length D (a positive integer; several roads may join the same towns, and a road may join a town to itself). All the remaining lines are questions `S T`. For each question print the length of the shortest route from S to T, which is 0 when S and T are the same town, or `unreachable` when there is no route. Route lengths stay far below 2^53.
